g.text: What the procurement module is made of, and what it is allowed to touch
Thin by design: it resolves the route
model, picks the language, calls one
service method and redirects. No rule
lives here, so no rule can be bypassed
by calling the service from elsewhere.
Every query runs inside a tenant binding
(SET LOCAL inside an open transaction, NULLIF(GUC,'')).
